data.title: Voltline Electronics - Official Return & Warranty Policy
data.text: Voltline Electronics provides a 30-day return policy from the date of delivery for all consumer audio products. Items in original condition may be returned for a full refund or replacement. Proof of purchase is required. In addition, all hardware products carry a 1-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects from the date of purchase. For warranty claims on audio products failing to charge or maintain power, proof of defect via photo or short video is required before a return merchandise authorization (RMA) is generated. Original retail packaging is encouraged but is not required for verified warranty claims involving hardware defects.

data.subject: Warranty Claim: AeroSound Pro Earbuds - Order DEMO-VL-89412
data.body:
Dear Voltline Support Team,

I am writing to file a warranty claim for my AeroSound Pro Wireless Earbuds (Order #DEMO-VL-89412, delivered on October 12, 2026).

After 19 days of normal use, the right earbud ceased charging. Per your published warranty policy: "all hardware products carry a 1-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects." Furthermore, as this issue has arisen within the 30-day return window ("Voltline Electronics provides a 30-day return policy from the date of delivery"), I request a warranty replacement or refund.

Proof of purchase is confirmed from the attached order details. Please advise on how to submit the defect video note for authorization.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
